title: The Message: tested reroll and interactive story branch
evidence_scope: Recorded render/lineage/hash verification plus observed live GUI behavior and a reviewed restored-draft screenshot. UI restoration is an observed test, not an automated assertion.

visual_limitations: Note unfolds and refolds approximately; exact origami and hand timing remain model-dependent.

story_choices.input_basis: Cafe Take 2 actual ending image and saved story context

choices.title: Elira Folds the Note
choices.idea: Elira uses her right hand to fold the note back into a compact rectangle. She tucks the folded paper into the front pocket of her burgundy jacket.

choices.title: Arin Slides Out the Key
choices.idea: Arin reaches his right hand down toward his trouser pocket and slides out the small metal key. He holds it up between his thumb and forefinger for Elira to see.

choices.title: Elira Tucks Note Away
choices.idea: Elira tucks the unfolded note into her back pocket without folding it. She shifts her gaze from Arin down toward the table surface.
